title: Oil falls as supply concerns ease
section_path: Oil falls as supply concerns ease
section_path_text: Oil falls as supply concerns ease
summary:
Main
Energy markets dipped, as supply disruption concerns in the Middle East eased. Precious metals fell following the Fed's rate hike. By Daniel Hynes
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-09-17 105148.png | assets/2026-09-17_oil-falls-as-supply-concerns-ease_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_cc7e28e952e8.png

Market Commentary
Crude oil prices gave back recent gains as recent supply disruptions began to resolve.

children.title: Main
children.summary: Energy markets dipped, as supply disruption concerns in the Middle East eased. Precious metals fell following the Fed's rate hike.

children.title: Market Commentary
children.summary: Crude oil prices gave back recent gains as recent supply disruptions began to resolve. Saudi Arabia said it expects to return about half of the capacity of its East-West pipeline within days after shutting it last week when it was attacked by drones.

children.title: Chart of the Day
children.summary: Investors continue to pile into gold-backed EFTs despite the prospect of higher interest rates. August recorded the first monthly gain in gold held in ETFs since April.
